invariants.rationale: Drawable#draw is invoked on selection, so it must not be null.
Batch is passed to Drawable#draw, requiring it to be non-null.
BitmapFont is used in various font.get* and font.getData() calls.
font.getLineHeight() is used for geometry; a positive line height is typical and assumed.
x is used as a float coordinate; adding 0.0f does not change its value, confirming it is finite.
